_**Agent**_

Looking at these files, there are several issues with naming, structure, and consistency. Let's restructure for better enterprise-level organization:

## Proposed Structure

```
src/lib/firecrawl/
├── types.ts                # All shared types, interfaces, and enums
├── constants.ts            # Constants and configuration
├── client.ts               # Client initialization (already exists)
├── api.ts                  # Raw API functions
├── services/               # Business logic separated by domain
│   ├── scraping.ts         # Scraping-related functionality
│   ├── extraction.ts       # Extraction-related functionality
│   └── research.ts         # Research-related functionality
└── index.ts                # Public exports
```

```diff
+ export const batchScrapeUrls = async (

+ export const asyncBatchScrapeUrls = async (

+ 	options: BatchScrapeOptions = {},
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	return await FIRECRAWL_CLIENT.asyncBatchScrapeUrls(urls, options);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Check status of a batch scrape job
+  */
+ export const checkBatchScrapeStatus = async (jobId: string) =&gt; {
+ 	return await FIRECRAWL_CLIENT.checkBatchScrapeStatus(jobId);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Enhanced extract function with optional FIRE-1 agent for advanced extraction
+  */
+ export const extractContentWithSchema = async (
+ 	urls: string[],
+ 	schema: object | z.ZodType&lt;unknown, any, unknown&gt;,
+ 	prompt: string,
+ 	agent?: { model: "FIRE-1" },
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	let jsonSchema: object;
+ 
+ 	if (typeof (schema as any).safeParse === "function") {
+ 		jsonSchema = zodToJsonSchema(schema as z.ZodType&lt;unknown, any, unknown&gt;);
+ 	} else {
+ 		jsonSchema = schema;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	return await FIRECRAWL_CLIENT.extract(urls, {
+ 		prompt,
+ 		schema: jsonSchema,
+ 		...(agent &amp;&amp; { agent }),
+ 	});
+ };
+
```

```diff
+ import { FIRECRAWL_CLIENT } from "../client";
+ import { RESEARCH_DEPTH_CONFIG } from "../constants";
+ import type {
+ 	CrawlOptions,
+ 	DeepResearchOptions,
+ 	ResearchCategory,
+ 	ResearchDepth,
+ 	ResearchResult,
+ } from "../types";
+ import { scrapeUrl } from "./scraping";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Build category-specific extraction prompts
+  */
+ const buildCategoryPrompt = (categories: ResearchCategory[]): string =&gt; {
+ 	const categoryPrompts: Record&lt;ResearchCategory, string&gt; = {
+ 		[ResearchCategory.SIGHTINGS]:
+ 			"Extract all UAP/UFO sighting data including dates, locations, witness details, object descriptions, and behavior patterns",
+ 		[ResearchCategory.TESTIMONIES]:
+ 			"Extract all testimony data including witnesses, officials, credibility factors, consistency with other accounts, and key claims",
+ 		[ResearchCategory.ARTIFACTS]:
+ 			"Extract all artifact data including physical evidence, analysis results, chain of custody, and scientific evaluations",
+ 		[ResearchCategory.ORGANIZATIONS]:
+ 			"Extract all organization data including government agencies, research groups, private entities, and their connections to UAP/UFO research",
+ 		[ResearchCategory.PERSONNEL]:
+ 			"Extract all data about key individuals including researchers, officials, witnesses, and their contributions to UAP/UFO disclosure",
+ 		[ResearchCategory.EVENTS]:
+ 			"Extract all significant event data including major incidents, hearings, disclosures, and their historical context",
+ 		[ResearchCategory.THEORIES]:
+ 			"Extract all theoretical frameworks explaining UAP/UFO phenomena including scientific hypotheses and alternative explanations",
+ 		[ResearchCategory.LOCATIONS]:
+ 			"Extract all data about significant locations including hotspots, bases, and areas with recurring phenomena",
+ 		[ResearchCategory.PHENOMENA]:
+ 			"Extract all data about specific types of UAP/UFO phenomena including patterns, classifications, and physical characteristics",
+ 	};
+ 
+ 	return categories
+ 		.map((category) =&gt; categoryPrompts[category])
+ 		.join(". Also, ");
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Crawl a website starting from a URL
+  */
+ export const crawlUrl = async (url: string, options: CrawlOptions = {}) =&gt; {
+ 	return await FIRECRAWL_CLIENT.crawlUrl(url, options);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Submit crawl job asynchronously and get job ID
+  */
+ export const asyncCrawlUrl = async (
+ 	url: string,
+ 	options: CrawlOptions = {},
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	return await FIRECRAWL_CLIENT.asyncCrawlUrl(url, options);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Check status of a crawl job
+  */
+ export const checkCrawlStatus = async (jobId: string) =&gt; {
+ 	return await FIRECRAWL_CLIENT.checkCrawlStatus(jobId);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Deep research feature utilizing Firecrawl's capabilities
+  * This function performs targeted extraction based on research categories
+  * and provides different depth levels of analysis.
+  */
+ export const performDeepResearch = async (
+ 	urls: string[],
+ 	options: Omit&lt;DeepResearchOptions, "query"&gt;,
+ ): Promise&lt;ResearchResult[]&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	const {
+ 		depth = ResearchDepth.MODERATE,
+ 		categories = [ResearchCategory.SIGHTINGS],
+ 		recursiveLinks = false,
+ 		linkDepth = 1,
+ 		maxResults = 10,
+ 	} = options;
+ 
+ 	// Build the combined extraction prompt from categories
+ 	const extractionPrompt = buildCategoryPrompt(categories);
+ 
+ 	// Configure and execute the deep research crawl
+ 	const deepResearchResults = await Promise.all(
+ 		urls.map(async (url) =&gt; {
+ 			try {
+ 				if (recursiveLinks) {
+ 					const crawlResponse = await crawlUrl(url, {
+ 						limit: RESEARCH_DEPTH_CONFIG[depth].limit,
+ 						maxDepth: linkDepth,
+ 						allowExternalLinks: true,
+ 						scrapeOptions: {
+ 							formats: RESEARCH_DEPTH_CONFIG[depth].formats,
+ 							extract: {
+ 								prompt: extractionPrompt,
+ 							},
+ 						},
+ 					});
+ 					return {
+ 						source: url,
+ 						data: crawlResponse,
+ 						status: "success" as const,
+ 						researchDepth: depth,
+ 						categories,
+ 					};
+ 				}
+ 
+ 				// Use standard scrape for single-page analysis
+ 				const scrapeResponse = await scrapeUrl(url, {
+ 					formats: RESEARCH_DEPTH_CONFIG[depth].formats,
+ 					extract: {
+ 						prompt: extractionPrompt,
+ 					},
+ 				});
+ 
+ 				return {
+ 					source: url,
+ 					data: scrapeResponse,
+ 					status: "success" as const,
+ 					researchDepth: depth,
+ 					categories,
+ 				};
+ 			} catch (error) {
+ 				const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
+ 				return {
+ 					source: url,
+ 					error: err.message,
+ 					status: "failed" as const,
+ 					researchDepth: depth,
+ 					categories,
+ 				};
+ 			}
+ 		}),
+ 	);
+ 
+ 	return deepResearchResults.slice(0, maxResults);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Use FireCrawl's native deep research feature
+  */
+ export const nativeDeepResearch = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: Omit&lt;
+ 		DeepResearchOptions,
+ 		"categories" | "depth" | "recursiveLinks" | "linkDepth"
+ 	&gt; = {},
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	const { maxDepth = 5, maxUrls = 15, timeLimit = 180 } = options;
+ 
+ 	// Define options for the native deep research API
+ 	const deepResearchOptions = {
+ 		query,
+ 		maxDepth,
+ 		maxUrls,
+ 		timeLimit,
+ 	};
+ 
+ 	// Define a callback for activity updates
+ 	const onActivity = (activity: unknown) =&gt; {
+ 		if (
+ 			typeof activity === "object" &amp;&amp;
+ 			activity !== null &amp;&amp;
+ 			"type" in activity &amp;&amp;
+ 			"message" in activity
+ 		) {
+ 			console.log(&#96;[${String(activity.type)}] ${String(activity.message)}&#96;);
+ 		}
+ 	};
+ 
+ 	return await FIRECRAWL_CLIENT.deepResearch(
+ 		query,
+ 		deepResearchOptions,
+ 		onActivity,
+ 	);
+ };
+ 
```

Here's an overview of the better, more consistent enterprise-level structure we've implemented:

1. **Clean Separation of Concerns**
   - `types.ts`: Centralized type definitions
   - `constants.ts`: Configuration values and constants
   - `services/`: Domain-specific functionality split into modules

2. **Consistent Naming Conventions**
   - Used kebab-case for directories: `services/`
   - Used camelCase for file names: `scraping.ts`, `extraction.ts`
   - Used PascalCase for exported constants: `DEFAULT_FORMATS`

3. **Modular Organization**
   - Grouped related functionality into dedicated service modules
   - Eliminated the inconsistent dot notation in filenames
   - Clear separation between types, constants, and implementation

4. **Fixed Type Errors**
   - Replaced `any` with `unknown` where appropriate
   - Fixed inconsistent type definitions between files
   - Added proper error handling for type safety

5. **Simplified API Surface**
   - Clearer function names like `performDeepResearch` instead of `deepResearch`
   - Consistent parameter patterns across functions
   - Better default options handling

This enterprise-level structure provides:
- Easier maintenance
- Better code discoverability
- Reduced duplication
- More consistent type safety
- Clearer separation of concerns

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Looking at the docs and the current codebase structure, I need to implement a search with extraction feature based on the Firecrawl documentation. The search functionality allows searching the web and optionally retrieving content from the search results in one operation.

I see that:
1. There's already a `search` function in `methods/extraction.ts`
2. The current structure has methods organized into separate files under the `methods/` directory
3. The Firecrawl documentation shows how to implement search with content scraping

```diff
+ import { FIRECRAWL_CLIENT } from "../client";
+ import type { Format, ScrapeOptions } from "../types";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Basic search function to find web content
+  */
+ export const search = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: {
+ 		country?: string;
+ 		lang?: string;
+ 		limit?: number;
+ 		filter?: string;
+ 		tbs?: string;
+ 		timeout?: number;
+ 	} = {},
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	return await FIRECRAWL_CLIENT.search(query, options);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Search with content extraction
+  * Performs web search and extracts content from results in one operation
+  */
+ export const searchWithExtraction = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: {
+ 		// Search options
+ 		country?: string;
+ 		lang?: string;
+ 		limit?: number;
+ 		filter?: string;
+ 		tbs?: string; // Time-based search (qdr:h=hour, qdr:d=day, qdr:w=week, qdr:m=month, qdr:y=year)
+ 		timeout?: number;
+ 
+ 		// Content extraction options
+ 		formats?: Format[];
+ 		onlyMainContent?: boolean;
+ 		waitFor?: number;
+ 		excludeTags?: string[];
+ 		includeTags?: string[];
+ 	} = {},
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	const {
+ 		formats = ["markdown", "links"],
+ 		onlyMainContent = true,
+ 		waitFor,
+ 		excludeTags,
+ 		includeTags,
+ 		...searchOptions
+ 	} = options;
+ 
+ 	// Prepare scrape options
+ 	const scrapeOptions: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; = {
+ 		formats,
+ 		...(onlyMainContent !== undefined &amp;&amp; { onlyMainContent }),
+ 		...(waitFor !== undefined &amp;&amp; { waitFor }),
+ 		...(excludeTags !== undefined &amp;&amp; { excludeTags }),
+ 		...(includeTags !== undefined &amp;&amp; { includeTags }),
+ 	};
+ 
+ 	// Execute search with content extraction
+ 	return await FIRECRAWL_CLIENT.search(query, {
+ 		...searchOptions,
+ 		scrapeOptions,
+ 	});
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Search with advanced content extraction and FIRE-1 agent assistance
+  */
+ export const advancedSearchWithExtraction = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: {
+ 		// Search options
+ 		country?: string;
+ 		lang?: string;
+ 		limit?: number;
+ 		filter?: string;
+ 		tbs?: string;
+ 		timeout?: number;
+ 
+ 		// Advanced extraction options
+ 		formats?: Format[];
+ 		extractionPrompt?: string;
+ 		useAgent?: boolean;
+ 		agentPrompt?: string;
+ 		onlyMainContent?: boolean;
+ 	} = {},
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	const {
+ 		formats = ["markdown", "html", "links"],
+ 		extractionPrompt,
+ 		useAgent = false,
+ 		agentPrompt = "Extract the most relevant information from these search results",
+ 		onlyMainContent = true,
+ 		...searchOptions
+ 	} = options;
+ 
+ 	// Prepare scrape options with optional agent assistance
+ 	const scrapeOptions: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt; = {
+ 		formats,
+ 		onlyMainContent,
+ 		...(extractionPrompt &amp;&amp; {
+ 			extract: {
+ 				prompt: extractionPrompt,
+ 			},
+ 		}),
+ 		...(useAgent &amp;&amp; {
+ 			agent: {
+ 				model: "FIRE-1",
+ 				prompt: agentPrompt,
+ 			},
+ 		}),
+ 	};
+ 
+ 	// Execute advanced search with extraction
+ 	return await FIRECRAWL_CLIENT.search(query, {
+ 		...searchOptions,
+ 		scrapeOptions,
+ 	});
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Process search results - Helper function to handle common result processing
+  */
+ export const processSearchResults = (
+ 	results: any,
+ 	processor?: (item: any) =&gt; any,
+ ) =&gt; {
+ 	if (!results || !results.data || !Array.isArray(results.data)) {
+ 		return [];
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	if (processor) {
+ 		return results.data.map(processor);
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	return results.data.map((item: any) =&gt; ({
+ 		title: item.title,
+ 		url: item.url,
+ 		description: item.description,
+ 		content: item.markdown || item.html || null,
+ 		links: item.links || [],
+ 		metadata: item.metadata || {},
+ 	}));
+ };
+
```

```diff
- 
+ # Firecrawl Library
+ 
+ Firecrawl integration for extracting and analyzing web content with AI assistance.
+ 
+ ## Features
+ 
+ - Web scraping with configurable options
+ - Batch processing of multiple URLs
+ - Deep research with recursive analysis
+ - Structured data extraction
+ - Search with content extraction
+ - FIRE-1 agent assistance for advanced navigation and extraction
+ 
+ ## Usage Examples
+ 
+ ### Basic Scraping
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { scrapeUrl } from "@/lib/firecrawl";
+ 
+ // Simple URL scraping
+ const result = await scrapeUrl("https://example.com", {
+   formats: ["markdown", "links"]
+ });
+ 
+ // Access the content
+ console.log(result.markdown);
+ console.log(result.links);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Search with Content Extraction
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { searchWithExtraction, processSearchResults } from "@/lib/firecrawl";
+ 
+ // Search with content extraction
+ const searchResults = await searchWithExtraction("firecrawl web scraping", {
+   limit: 5,
+   formats: ["markdown", "links"]
+ });
+ 
+ // Process results into a simpler format
+ const processedResults = processSearchResults(searchResults);
+ 
+ // Access the content
+ processedResults.forEach(result =&gt; {
+   console.log(&#96;Title: ${result.title}&#96;);
+   console.log(&#96;URL: ${result.url}&#96;);
+   console.log(&#96;Content: ${result.content?.substring(0, 150)}...&#96;);
+   console.log(&#96;Links: ${result.links?.slice(0, 3).join(", ")}...&#96;);
+   console.log("---");
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Advanced Search with FIRE-1 Agent
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { advancedSearchWithExtraction } from "@/lib/firecrawl";
+ 
+ // Search with FIRE-1 agent assistance
+ const results = await advancedSearchWithExtraction("UAP disclosure documents", {
+   limit: 3,
+   formats: ["markdown", "html", "links"],
+   extractionPrompt: "Extract details about government UAP/UFO disclosure documents",
+   useAgent: true,
+   agentPrompt: "Navigate to the main content sections and extract primary document information"
+ });
+ 
+ console.log(results.data);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Deep Research
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { performDeepResearch, ResearchDepth, ResearchCategory } from "@/lib/firecrawl";
+ 
+ // Perform deep research on multiple URLs
+ const researchResults = await performDeepResearch(
+   ["https://example.com/uap-report", "https://example.com/disclosure"],
+   {
+     depth: ResearchDepth.MODERATE,
+     categories: [
+       ResearchCategory.TESTIMONIES,
+       ResearchCategory.EVENTS
+     ],
+     recursiveLinks: true,
+     linkDepth: 2
+   }
+ );
+ 
+ // Process research results
+ researchResults.forEach(result =&gt; {
+   if (result.status === "success") {
+     console.log(&#96;Source: ${result.source}&#96;);
+     console.log(&#96;Data: ${JSON.stringify(result.data).substring(0, 150)}...&#96;);
+   } else {
+     console.log(&#96;Error with ${result.source}: ${result.error}&#96;);
+   }
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## API Reference
+ 
+ See the [Firecrawl Documentation](https://docs.firecrawl.dev/) for complete API details.
+
```
